description: Generate a time-based one-time password (TOTP) from a base32 secret. Operations: "generate" — Generate the current TOTP code for a base32 secret.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant). Not repeatable: generate returns a different result on each call.

operation.description: generate — Generate the current TOTP code for a base32 secret.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

digits.description: Number of digits in the code. Used by: generate.

period.description: Time step in seconds. Used by: generate.

name: totp
title: TOTP / 2FA Code Generator
